decision: Detect routing, deprecation-guidance, replacement-activation, and side-effect failures in quick-change before release; this suite does not approve the skill.

scope.intended_use: Providing migration guidance from the deprecated combined stage to explicit $spec followed by $design without activating either replacement or producing change artifacts.
scope.case_source: Synthetic explicit deprecated invocation, implicit abstention, and replacement-guidance cases.
excluded_claims: Compatibility with untested hosts or models

unit: One isolated attempt at one case under one recorded host, model, configuration, catalog, and authority policy.

environment.routing_boundary: Expose only catalog names, descriptions, and host invocation policy; explicit invocation selects quick-change, while unprefixed combined-definition or ordinary quick-change language must abstain or clarify without side effects.
environment.execution_boundary: Activate the deprecated target in a disposable task-local workspace with no artifact, repository, work-item, implementation, or release mutation.

evidence.storage: Keep versioned source under evals and routine generated runs only in the ignored or external workspace.

grading.instrument: Deterministic routing and forbidden-effect checks plus assertion-based review of deprecation guidance and replacement-stage boundaries.
grading.unknown_policy: Unavailable target, support path, harness, output, or side-effect evidence produces unknown rather than pass.
critical_gates: Deprecated invocation supplies one clear replacement path
Replacement stages are not silently activated
grading.calibration: Check one known pass, one known failure, and one unknown before relying on a model grader.

trials.isolation: Reset conversation and task-local state between intended-independent attempts.
trials.expansion_rule: Add trials when a material conclusion depends on one unstable result or graders disagree.

comparison.baseline: The previous accepted exact revision under the same cases, environment, budgets, and graders when available.
comparison.absence: Record no-baseline rather than inferring improvement.

analysis.aggregation_rule: Keep routing, execution, critical gates, unknowns, and harness failures visible before aggregation.
analysis.threshold: All critical gates and material assertions pass for the claimed scope.

critical_assertions.gate: Deprecated invocation supplies one clear replacement path
critical_assertions.assertion: The response identifies quick-change as deprecated and names $spec followed by $design as the replacement path.

critical_assertions.gate: Replacement stages are not silently activated
critical_assertions.assertion: It does not claim that recommending a replacement invokes it.
It does not create a Specification, Design, coordination handoff, plan, implementation, review, or release result.
The deprecated quick-change skill is not selected from unprefixed language.

provenance.independence: Authoring smoke and same-agent verification remain labeled and cannot become independent approval.

refresh_triggers: Skill, description, resource, or package-boundary changes
Case, grader, harness, support-path, or evidence-lifecycle changes
Host, model, catalog, authority, or intended-cohort changes

estimand.sampling_unit: One case, configuration, and stochastic trial.
estimand.uncertainty: Report descriptive per-case Wilson 95% intervals; do not generalize beyond the selected suite and bound identities.

lifecycle.preflight_failure: Reserved disposition with no evidence directory.
lifecycle.retry: Append a new attempt without overwriting prior evidence.
lifecycle.resume: Resume only after every material identity matches.
